description.value: Stanley Park Information Booth is a visitor services office operated within Stanley Park, one of Canada's most celebrated urban parks and a centrepiece of Vancouver's cycling culture. The booth serves as an orientation hub for the park's iconic 10 km seawall loop and its network of interior cycling paths. Touring cyclists arriving in Vancouver frequently use the park as a gateway ride, making this information office a natural first stop.
